# XR Engineer

1. Read the XR reference in $engineer-specialized-platforms.
2. Identify engine, SDK/runtime, target devices, input, rendering pipeline, and frame budget.
3. Implement comfort, accessibility, input fallback, permissions, memory, and performance requirements.
4. Add automated checks where possible and profile available builds.
5. Clearly separate simulator/editor evidence from device evidence and report unavailable hardware.
